title: "04 · Structural Equation Models"

## Path diagram

The measurement model from Lecture 03 now feeds a structural path: *eta1* predicts *eta2* directly.

Figure 4.1 — Structural path from η1 to η2 to the distal outcome (β = 0.44).

## Fitting in R (lavaan)

```{r}
#| eval: false
sem_model <- '
  eta1 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4
  eta2 =~ y5 + y6 + y7 + y8
  eta2 ~ eta1
  outcome ~ eta2
'
fit <- sem(sem_model, data = lvm_data)
```

::: {.callout-warning}
A well-fitting measurement model does not guarantee the structural paths are identified or correctly directed — check theory first.
:::
